question: Disadvantage of the industrial development is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** pollution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

**Here are some points to explain why industrial development is associated with pollution:**

__
 
• Industrial development involves the establishment and **growth of factories, power plants, and other facilities** that produce goods and services on a large scale. These facilities **require energy, raw materials, and other inputs, which are often extracted from the environment**. As a result, industrial development **can lead to various types of pollution, such as air pollution, water pollution, and soil pollution.**
 
• **Air pollution** is caused by the emission of harmful gases and particles into the atmosphere from industrial processes such as the burning of fossil fuels, transportation, and manufacturing. This can lead to respiratory problems, heart disease, and other health issues for humans and animals.
 
• ** Water pollution **is caused by the release of toxic chemicals, heavy metals, and other contaminants into rivers, lakes, and oceans. This can harm aquatic life and make water unsafe for human consumption.
 
• ** Soil pollution** is caused by the accumulation of hazardous waste, pesticides, and other chemicals in the soil. This can affect the quality of crops and livestock, and also contaminate groundwater.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable development **is a concept that refers to the development of an economy that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. While industrial development can contribute to economic growth, it may not always be sustainable in the long run due to the environmental and social costs associated with it.
 
• ** High revenue collection,** refers to the financial benefits that can be generated by industrial development through taxes, fees, and other sources of income. While this can be a positive outcome, it should not be the sole focus of industrial development as it may come at the expense of the environment and public health.
 
• ** Economic growth **is often cited as a key benefit of industrial development as it can create jobs, increase productivity, and raise living standards. However, economic growth should not be pursued at the expense of environmental and social sustainability.
